test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a round table facing the centre. Yamini is the immediate neighbor of both Yojana and Yogita. Yashmita is sitting second to the left of Yojana. Yukti sits second to the right of Yamini. Yashvi is sitting third to the right of Yogita. Who is the immediate neighbor of both Yukti and Yamini?
solution: Given: Six students are seated around a circular table, all facing toward the center. 1) Yamini is the immediate neighbor of both Yojana and Yogita. 2) Yashmita is seated in the second position to the left of Yojana.
